inv.desc_es:
TEMPOCASA - MADRID, SAN ISIDRO vende Local comercial de 164m² situado en la Calle Morenés Arteaga con acceso independiente del portal.

Es un local ideal para comercio, ya que se encuentra localizado a unos cuantos metros de la calle principal Calle General Ricardos, calle principal del barrio con mucho paso de personas a todas horas del día.

Tiene varios puntos a destacar:

- Local muy amplio.
- Muy luminoso.
- Con Vado.
- La cercanía del metro URGEL.
- La cercanía a General Ricardos a 4 minutos.

Zona perfecta para tu próxima inversión
A 20 MINUTOS A PIE DE MADRID RÍO.
Fácil acceso a A42, M30, está cercano a las calles comerciales como Calle de Antonio de Leyva, Calle General Ricardos y a 5 minutos del metro Urgel.

Este local es una oportunidad única para aquellos que buscan una propiedad con potencial en una de las zonas más en desarrollo de Madrid.

¡No pierdas la oportunidad de convertir este espacio en un proyecto perfecto, contáctanos para más información y para programar una visita!

inv.desc_en:
TEMPOCASA - MADRID, SAN ISIDRO sells a 164m² commercial premises located on Calle Morenés Arteaga with independent access from the building entrance.

It is an ideal premises for commerce, as it is located a few meters from the main street Calle General Ricardos, the main street of the neighborhood with a lot of pedestrian traffic at all hours of the day.

It has several highlights:

- Very spacious premises.
- Very bright.
- With a loading bay.
- Close to the URGEL metro station.
- Close to General Ricardos (4 minutes away).

Perfect area for your next investment.
20 MINUTES WALK FROM MADRID RÍO.
Easy access to A42, M30, it is close to commercial streets such as Calle de Antonio de Leyva, Calle General Ricardos and 5 minutes from Urgel metro station.

This premises is a unique opportunity for those seeking a property with potential in one of the most developing areas of Madrid.

Don't miss the opportunity to turn this space into a perfect project, contact us for more information and to schedule a visit!

LEGAL NOTICE: We remind our clients that the information provided does not constitute a genuine binding or contractual offer. This advertisement is provisional, and the photographs and data included in it are subject to possible modifications, as a consequence of commercial, legal, technical requirements or by express order of the property. The information contained herein aims to reflect an orientation on the properties at the date of its publication. Both the data, and the images and plans may be subject to changes, so we invite you, if you need more accurate and detailed information, to contact us and we will attend to you as soon as possible. The contents are for informational purposes only and under no circumstances should they be used or considered as an offer of sale or financing, a request for an offer to buy or finance, or a recommendation to carry out any other transaction, unless expressly stated. The information and documentation to be offered in accordance with the provisions of Royal Decree 515/1989 (of April 21, concerning the protection of consumers regarding the information to be provided in the sale and lease of dwellings), will be made available to potential buyers in the respective territorial delegations managing the property.
